name: Humble Beginnings
summary: In Cathedral Square, Baros Alexston asks you to search his family's burned farm in Westfall. Thieves hold the ruins, and he hopes to recover the compass he treasured as a boy.

sections.title: A Builder's Roots
sections.body: Baros Alexston once worked the fields of Westfall. Now he is Stormwind City's accomplished architect, advising on stonework and city buildings. Few in the kingdom have made such a journey from farm to city. Yet Baros remains bound to the humble beginnings that shaped him.

sections.title: Tragedy in Westfall
sections.body: Lawlessness swept across Westfall and reached the Alexston Farmstead. Bandits and vagrants burned the house, driving Baros's father from his livelihood. Family heirlooms remained behind amid the fire and occupation. Now Baros asks you to search the ruined, bandit-held farmstead west of Sentinel Hill for his first compass, hidden before the home fell.

faq.answer: Baros Alexston is Stormwind's City Architect, and he lives near Cathedral Square. He grew up as a farmer's son in Westfall, then left the countryside to learn the craft of building.

faq.q: Where is the Alexston Farmstead located?
faq.answer: The Alexston Farmstead lies west of Sentinel Hill in central Westfall. Thieves and rogues aligned with the Defias rabble burned it and took control of the property.

faq.q: Why is the compass important to Baros?
faq.answer: The compass matters to Baros for its sentimental value. It was his first navigation tool as a boy on the farm, and recalls his path from rural laborer to architectural planner. It has no use in his current craft, but remains an irreplaceable relic of his past.

faq.q: Who burned down the Alexston farm?
faq.answer: Thieves and outlaws terrorizing Westfall razed the farm. Stormwind's military was spread thin and could not protect outlying homesteads, so bandits seized the land and drove out the Alexston family.

faq.q: Where can the compass be found on the farm?
faq.answer: Baros's compass was hidden before the family fled. You can find it in a small chest amid the charred ruins of the main farmhouse.
Baros's father survived the raid and fled the farm. He could not carry their possessions through the flames and bandits, but remembered where the family had hidden valuable keepsakes.

angles.text: The Alexston Farmstead's fate reflects the decline of Westfall's yeomanry. Generations of human farmers have been driven from their land by lawlessness on Stormwind's doorstep.
When you venture into Westfall for people in the capital, you cross from Stormwind's safe streets to nearby frontier lands left unprotected.
